label: School-Term Soak (Soak variant on the Load dataset)
note: Reuses loadtest/exports/load_export.json — run generate_data.py --tier load first. Full endurance run: 5h sustained at the Campina Grande (load) scale. k6/lib/auth.js refreshes each VU's JWT before the 2h expiry so token expiry doesn't masquerade as a failure mid-soak. Watch for DB connection/pool drift, memory growth, and interaction with the APScheduler jobs in app/utils/scheduler_setup.py firing throughout the run.
